nodes.label: Green Street Orange Line stop
nodes.description: MBTA Orange Line Green Street station, four blocks down Green Street from the health center.

nodes.label: Route 39 bus stop on Centre St
nodes.description: Route 39 bus stop on Centre Street near 640. Connects to Forest Hills and Copley Square.

nodes.label: Burroughs Street public lot
nodes.description: Public parking lot on Burroughs Street, one block past the health center, 2-hour limit.

nodes.label: Centre Street metered parking
nodes.description: Metered street parking on Centre Street near 640. 1- and 2-hour meters, often full during business hours.

nodes.label: Under-building patient parking
nodes.description: Five patient-reserved spaces under the building, accessed from Green Street (one-way). Arrive early.

nodes.label: Post office across the street
nodes.description: U.S. Post Office directly across Centre Street from the health center entrance. The clearest landmark for finding 640.

nodes.label: Corner of Centre St and Green St
nodes.description: Street corner where Centre Street meets Green Street. Health center is on this corner.

nodes.label: Main entrance (640 Centre St)
nodes.description: Main entrance to the health center at 640 Centre Street. Automatic accessible doors.

nodes.label: 1st floor front desk
nodes.description: Front desk on the left as you enter. Check-in for all departments.

nodes.label: Lab window
nodes.description: Phlebotomy / lab window down the main hallway on your right. Walk-ins accepted.

nodes.label: Behavioral Health hallway
nodes.description: Behavioral Health offices down the hall to the right from the front desk.

edges.instruction: Exit the Green Street T stop and turn left — walk four blocks up Green Street, past the auto shop, to the corner of Centre Street.
At the corner, the post office is on your right across Centre Street.
From the post office, the health center is directly across the street at 640 Centre St.
The main entrance is right on the corner — look for 640 Centre Street with the automatic doors.
Step off the bus and walk along Centre Street to 640 — the health center is on the corner of Green St, across from the post office.
From the meters, walk along Centre Street to 640 — the health center is on the corner across from the post office.
From the Burroughs lot, walk back along Centre Street toward Green Street — the health center is one block down on the corner across from the post office.
From the under-building parking, take the elevator up to the 1st floor lobby.
Inside the main entrance, the front desk is on your left.
From the front desk, walk down the main hallway — the lab window is on your right.
From the front desk, head down the hall to the right to reach Behavioral Health offices.
